headline: You're not behind. You're *forming.*
intro: I'm Altansuvd, and my name means golden pearl. I write about the quiet years: the ones with no applause, when growth happens out of sight, one layer at a time.
now: Now writing - notes from the quiet years
Making - a short film about my twenties
Learning - to be soft and strong at once
manifesto: Some years, nothing seems to happen. No applause, no proof, no headline. Just work, doubt and starting over. Those are the years a pearl is made: in the dark, around what hurts, ==one quiet layer at a time.==

layers.name: The grain
layers.title: It began with what I didn't have.
layers.text: No famous school, no money, no map. Just a stubborn belief in what I could learn.

layers.name: The dark
layers.title: Then came the years no one saw.
layers.text: A new country, a new alphabet, and the constant feeling of being behind.

layers.name: The layers
layers.title: Slowly, it became something.
layers.text: Systems, good people and time turned what hurt into something solid.

layers.name: The light
layers.title: Now I'm opening the shell.
layers.text: So anyone still in the dark can see what they might be forming.

measured_title: I scored every year of my twenties.
measured_text: Six scores a year, from happiness to inner strength: sixty-six honest numbers. They told me what my feelings couldn't. My lowest years for achievement were my highest for growth.
forwho_title: Maybe you're in your quiet years too.
forwho_text: Working hard with no one clapping. Starting again somewhere new. Wondering if any of it counts. I've been there, and I'm still learning. You're welcome here, exactly as you are.
invite_title: Would you be my friend on this road?
